observations: Reviewed all 26 sub-25-pixel components in three paired crop sheets. The bird eye and small closed triangular detail in the upper foliage are real outlined details and retained, including the 9-pixel triangle. Twenty-four acute disconnected tips (28 pixels total) have an explicit connectivity-only mask. The two additional narrow closed triangles above the animal, 40 and 28 pixels, are also retained. New numbered overlay and uniform fill inspected: outer margins excluded; left and right frame sections, upper foliage, animal eye/ear and body, bird beak/eye, separate feathers and eleven back panels, tail and lower foliage remain distinct. Open strokes within the animal's limbs and body are not separate regions. Names use visible animal/bird forms without claiming a historical subject identification. Lower animal body and curled tail are one continuous region. Retained earlier geometry for existing local saves.
